article.title: Why a Meeting Note Needs an Owner
article.why: 練習用簡單英文把會議紀錄轉成明確 action、owner 與 deadline。
article.author: OpenAI learning editor

paragraphs.en:
A meeting note can be useful even when it is only a few lines long. The problem is that many notes record what people discussed but do not say who should act next. After the meeting, everyone remembers the conversation, yet nobody is sure who owns the next step.

A simple fix is to give each important action an owner. For example, instead of writing, ‘Check the customer data,’ write, ‘Mika will check the customer data by Wednesday.’ The second version answers two questions: who will do the work, and when should the team expect it?

An owner is not always the person who does every part of the task. The owner is the person responsible for making sure the action moves forward. That person may ask someone else for data, request a review, or report a blocker. The important point is that the team knows where responsibility sits.

This also makes status updates easier. If a deadline is close, the team does not need to ask everyone for progress. They can ask the owner. If the task cannot continue because information is missing, the owner can explain the problem and request help.

Of course, not every sentence in a meeting note needs an owner. Background information, ideas, and decisions may simply be recorded. Owners are most useful for actions that require follow-up.

Before ending a meeting, take one minute to review the action list. Ask: What happens next? Who owns it? When should it be checked? This small habit can prevent work from disappearing between meetings and can make handoffs much clearer.

The same rule helps in online meetings. A chat message or shared document may contain many comments, but comments are easy to overlook. Turning the final comment into a clear action with one owner and one date creates a visible commitment. It also helps new team members understand which items are active and which points were only discussion.
paragraphs.zh: 會議紀錄不需要很長，但重要 action 最好寫清楚 owner 與期限。Owner 不一定親自完成所有細節，而是負責確保事情持續往前的人。會議結束前花一分鐘確認『下一步是什麼、誰負責、何時檢查』，能減少工作在會議之間消失。
paragraphs.ja: 会議メモは長くなくても構いませんが、重要なアクションには担当者と期限を明記すると有効です。担当者はすべてを自分で行う人ではなく、次の行動が前へ進むことに責任を持つ人です。会議終了前に、次の行動・担当者・確認時期をそろえると、手戻りや抜け漏れを減らせます。

phrases.example: The owner makes sure the action moves forward.

grammar.title: Who owns the next step?
grammar.body: Who 作主詞時不需要 do/does，直接接動詞。

business.example: Before we close, who owns this action?

business.term: When should we check this again?
business.example: When should we check this again?

quiz.question: Why is an owner useful in a meeting note?
quiz.answer: Because the team knows who is responsible for moving the action forward.

quiz.question: Output: Write one action with an owner and deadline.
quiz.answer: Example: Ken will confirm the customer list by Friday.
